senses.gloss:
वेप् वेप् (connected with the Caus. of
rt. 1. वी), cl. 1. A. वेपते (ep. also P. वे-
पति), विवेपे, वेपिष्यते, वेपितुम्, to tremble,
shake, move about, quiver: Caus. वेपयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to tremble or move; [cf. Lat. vibrare;
Old Germ. weibon, weibjan.]

वेपथु, उस्, m. trembling, tremor.
—वेपथु-
परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, seized with or affected by tremor.
—वेपथु-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, possessing tremor, trem-
bling.
—वेपथु-मत्, अन्, अती, अत्, possessed of
tremor, trembling, quaking.

वेपन, अम्, n. tremor, trembling; the discharg-
ing of a bow, (in this sense perhaps to be connected
with Caus. of rt. 1. वी.)

वेपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shaking, quiver-
ing, quaking.

वेपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to tremble or quake,
agitating; driving away, dispelling, (probably con-
nected with Caus. of rt. 1. वी; according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda VIII. 12, 2 = तमांसि वर्जयत्.)

वेपस्, अस्, n. trembling, tremor, (Sāy. = वेपन);
act, activity, energy (enumerated among the कर्म-
नामानि in Naigh. II. 1); = अनवद्य (according
to Śabda-k.).

वेपी, in Ṛg-veda VI. 22, 5. perhaps ‘accom-
panied with ceremonial acts,’ (Sāy. = वेपस्, i. e. या-
गादि-लक्षणं कर्म तद्-वती.)

वेप, अस्, ई, अम्, swinging, moving, oscillating
(Ved.); (अस्), m. trembling, quivering.
